objective: Operationalize external-source provenance probing in scheduled/manual scientific validation.

baseline.description: Historical cycle record predates the current cumulative-lifecycle schema; the original baseline revision was not captured in the record.

reliability.reason: Historical record did not preserve a before/after reliability measurement.

measurement.trade_off: Live source reachability is provenance evidence, not immutable benchmark truth.

evidence: Five canonical source contracts are probed or explicitly marked derived.
Probe output records HTTP status, content type, size, and SHA-256 for live endpoints.
The fail-closed scientific gate remains release-blocking.

findings: Source probes can establish endpoint provenance without promoting mutable live data to benchmark truth.
Scientific validation must remain fail-closed when immutable evidence is absent.
